verdict.rationale: Reclaim's docs say Focus Time uses AI to flexibly defend a weekly focus goal and that Habits flex and adapt as things come up. They also say Reclaim automatically reschedules smart events to the next best time when conflicts or overbookings occur, guided by P1–P4 priorities. Community users report the bot adding routines and reserving time so meetings don't take over the day. Missing for 10: no documentation of what happens when no alternative slot exists (i.e. a guarantee habits are never dropped), and only anecdotal rather than detailed hands-on corroboration of conflict rescheduling.
